merge_base(repo, 'HEAD', 'main')
    assert head == base, (head, base)
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == ''
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='chupa-serve-custody-') as directory:
        rig = CoreRig(Path(directory))
        assert_core_wiring(rig)
        llm = FakeLLM([])
        observed = []
        original = Driver.from_config
        def observe(config, **kwargs):
            driver = original(config, **kwargs)
            observed.append(driver)
            return driver
        before = asyncio.all_tasks()
        with patch.object(Driver, 'from_config', side_effect=observe):
            assert await triage.triage_pass(rig.checkout, llm) == []
        assert len(observed) == 1
        driver = observed[0]
        assert driver.journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is driver.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert asyncio.all_tasks() == before
        assert llm.requests == [] and rig.exec.calls == []
        print(json.dumps({'head': head, 'base': base,
                          'triage_driver_shares_checkout_journal': False,
                          'triage_effects_share_checkout_journal': False,
                          'model_calls': len(llm.requests),
                          'process_calls': len(rig.exec.calls),
                          'new_tasks': len(asyncio.all_tasks() - before)}))
        driver.journal.close()
        rig.journal.close()
    assert await git.rev_parse(repo, 'HEAD') == head
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == ''
    print('HEAD unchanged; working tree clean')

asyncio.run(main())
